mcpjam-eval/evals.md:303:> If **Run all** is disabled, no models are selected or a run for that suite is already in progress. For
non-environment suites, a missing connected server also disables it. When every model the suite would run is out of MCPJam credits
, **Run all** and each case's **Run** button are disabled with an \"Out of MCPJam credits · resets in …\" tooltip — switching any
case to a model from your own providers re-enables those buttons. The header pickers will tell you which condition applies.\n/work
